title: Existence of the normalized derived direct-image comparison
statement: For compatible coefficient changes on the pro-etale sites, there exists a natural isomorphism between the derived direct image after restriction along the source coefficient map and restriction along the target coefficient map after derived direct image, satisfying the displayed unit-normalization equation of the parent node for every cochain complex.

source.place: Tag 0D6E, lemma-derived-pushforward-composition, comparison and normalization on K-injective resolutions

proof.text: Apply the general ringed-topos derived direct-image composition theorem to the two factorizations of the compatible coefficient-change morphism. Identify the exact restriction direct image with termwise restriction and identify the two underived composite module direct images by the sectionwise identity isomorphism. Transport the resulting composition comparison across the canonical right-derived-functor uniqueness isomorphisms. The defining unit equation of the general theorem becomes exactly the displayed equation after expanding the canonical quotient identifications in proEtaleRingDirectImageDerivedUnit. The K-injective resolution clause supplies invertibility of the comparison on representatives and hence a natural isomorphism on the derived categories.
